svg.text: Socket: 38 x 3 steel tube, 120 long, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End plate: 38 disc of 6 plate, welded across one end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cheeks: two 6 x 30 x 69 flat bar, welded under the plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred, 8 apart inside (use an 8 spacer while welding).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the 2.1 shear pin hole through both cheeks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6.5 across the socket 60 above the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Galvanise; paint the pin rating on the socket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tang slides between the cheeks freely.
